local.intro: The model runs right on this computer: no internet, no keys, your text never leaves the machine. Download one model if you want. It starts by itself when needed and is unloaded from memory when idle. It runs on the CPU, so it is slower than cloud services. All models fit a laptop with 16 GB of RAM.
local.runtimeMissing: The built-in AI engine was not found. Please reinstall Tishe.

qwen35_4b.title: Balanced
qwen35_4b.description: The plain Qwen 4B build. Careful with punctuation, but fixes few recognition errors in real conversations (our tests, 2026-10-06). The speedup build is more accurate and faster.

gemma4_e4b.title: Gemma
gemma4_e4b.description: Google's model, faithful to the original. Edits like the Gemma in Google's build with a speedup, but about 1.25 times slower.

gigachat31.title: Russian-native
gigachat31.description: Trained on Russian from the start. Only 1.8B of its 10B parameters are active per token, so it is faster than its size suggests. Needs more memory.

ruadapt_qwen3_4b.title: Qwen for Russian
ruadapt_qwen3_4b.description: Qwen3 4B (2507) with a Russian vocabulary and further training on Russian text. On the bench it fixes fewer errors than Gemma E2B and is half as fast (about 27 min per hour of recording).

nemotron3_nano_4b.title: Nemotron
nemotron3_nano_4b.description: NVIDIA's small model, officially English only. On the bench it left almost every line unchanged in both Russian and English, and is slower than Gemma (about 35 min per hour of recording).

qwen35_9b.title: Maximum
qwen35_9b.description: The smartest local model: best at context and hard corrections. The slowest.

qwen35_4b_mtp.title: Balanced
qwen35_4b_mtp.description: Qwen 4B in a newer build with a built-in speedup. More accurate and about 1.2 times faster than the plain Qwen 4B, but fixes half as many errors as Gemma in our tests.

gemma4_e2b_qat.title: Gemma light
gemma4_e2b_qat.description: The smaller Gemma in Google's official build, plus a speedup (+98 MB). Twice as fast as Gemma E4B (about 14 min per hour of recording) with about 2/3 of its fixes.

gemma4_e4b_qat.title: Gemma
gemma4_e4b_qat.description: The best quality in our tests (2026-10-06). Google's official build plus a speedup (+99 MB): edits like the plain Gemma E4B, about 1.25 times faster. About 26 min per hour of recording.

asr.whileDownloading: You can add recordings while it downloads: transcription starts once the model is ready.

llm.title: Editing needs a neural network
llm.what: The neural network fixes recognition mistakes and punctuation. We recommend the built-in one: it runs on this computer, and your text never leaves it.
llm.recommended: {{size}} on disk · needs about {{ram}} GB of memory · one-time download
llm.runtimeTitle: The built-in neural network is not available
llm.runtime: This build has no engine for the built-in neural network. You can connect your own server (Ollama, LM Studio) or a cloud service in $t(sidebar.llm).
llm.notSetUp: {{reason}} — the neural network cannot work without it. Turn editing on and finish the setup in $t(sidebar.llm).
llm.onDisk: Already on this computer — nothing to download.
